job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities




Design, develop, and implement AI-powered solutions using Snowflake Cortex capabilities.
Develop applications utilizing Cortex AI functions including COMPLETE, SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE, SENTIMENT, EXTRACT_ANSWER, and Cortex Search.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions leveraging enterprise data stored within Snowflake.
Develop and maintain Snowpark Python applications integrated with Cortex AI services.
Create semantic data models and AI-ready datasets for business consumption.
Design and optimize prompts, prompt templates, and AI workflows for enterprise use cases.
Develop chatbots, intelligent search solutions, document intelligence applications, and AI-assisted analytics capabilities
7-10 years of Data Engineering, Analytics, or AI Engineering experience.
3+ years of Snowflake development experience.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake Cortex AI services.
Strong Python and Snowpark development experience.
Experience with LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG architectures, and Vector Databases.
Strong SQL and data modeling skills.
Experience working with unstructured and semi-structured data.
Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic
